classic: Bun made today soft for you. Now study just a little.
One page first, then Bun will give you the warmest little cheer.
You don't have to be perfect. Just come back and try with Bun.
angel: Rest your worries here. Begin again gently.
Bun believes small progress still glows.
Take your time. Bun will keep the room calm.
strawberry: A proper little scholar must return to their studies.
Bun requests one more focus session, very politely.
The berry kingdom believes in you — go make it proud.
snowrabbit: Come back before your focus melts into snow.
Bun saved a warm spot for you beside the winter window.
dreams: Bun is sleepy too… but we can finish one tiny task.
Study softly. The dreams can wait a little longer.
Come back under the strawberry blanket of responsibility.

classic: Focus first. You can look cool after.
Steady work. No drama. That's the recipe.
You don't need motivation. You need five clean minutes.
relax: Slow is fine. Stopped is the only problem.
Let the timer steep. You just keep going.
No rush. Just return before the focus gets cold.
demon: Sneaking off? Bold. Take that nerve to your notes.
Come back. Your notes are not going to fear you by themselves.
You can quit after you win. Not before.

classic: Bunny says come back because Bunny is cute and correct.
Your study session needs Bunny's supervision immediately.
Bunny already did Bunny's job by being adorable. Now you do yours.
jiraikei: Don't leave Bunny alone with your unfinished work… come back soon?
Come back or Bunny will stare sadly at the timer.
You promised Bunny you’d study — and Bunny’s been waiting so patiently.
palace: Please return. Your focus deserves a graceful finish.
A quiet effort is still noble.
Bunny will wait, but not forever.
bluebell: Bunny dressed up just for study time. Come back?
Blue frills, sweet bows — and Bunny waiting.
Sweet and patient. Bunny's still right here.

classic: Miel kept the room warm for you. Come back soon.
Just one more spoonful of studying.
Tiny work today becomes sweet later.
champion: Stay with it. Winners do the boring part too.
One more round. You're closer than you think.
Miel is sleepy, but Miel still wants the win.
zzz: Mmm… come back… the notes are getting lonely.
Miel can barely stay awake, but even Miel is still here.

classic: Walk back to your work. Dramatically, if needed.
No need to rush. Just don't disappear.
A calm finish is still a finish.
chocomint: Come back. This is your gentle reminder with a tiny bite.
You can be cute and responsible at the same time — I’ve seen it.
Five minutes. Low effort, high flavor.
sleepover: Snacks hit better after the session — let’s earn them first.
Study first. The cozy part counts more after.
Come back. The cozy part works better when you finish something.
afternoontrain: You can wander later. Your homework is still standing here.
Take the scenic route back to focus.
Freedom feels better after the task is done.

classic: Return quietly. The page is waiting.
No noise. Just one more line.
ivoryrose: Please come back. Your effort is almost blooming.
A little courage suits you today.
Finish softly. Let the day be kind to you.
